question: Which hires could I end right now because we own something idle that would do the job, and what would that save me a day?

rules.open_hire: READ ME rules; start on or before 31 Oct 2026 and off-hire after it or none; $/day ex GST (week = 5 days, month = 22, inc GST / 1.1, blank GST: BE inc, NH ex).
rules.idle: Register Available or Yard, and FieldTrax under 1.0 engine hour from 2026-10-18T00:00:00+10:00 to 2026-10-31T23:59:59+10:00 (sum of positive increases, all devices). No device = unconfirmed.
rules.replaceable: Same category, project in the same state as the machine's depot; pairs chosen to save the most.

who_signs.rule: Priya N., Group Plant Manager, signs each proposal to end a hire before the supplier is contacted.
who_signs.source: READ ME A1 names Priya N. as Group Plant Manager and keeper of the register; confirmed by Tom Barber, 12 Nov 2026.

open_details: Supplier written as 'Hire Well'; read as Hirewell Pty Ltd. Not confirmed.

open_questions.title: Are these machines really Available?
open_questions.finding: 11 machines are Available on the register, but FieldTrax shows 64–83 h run from 18 to 31 Oct, about 36 h a week, like machines out on jobs. 9 of them had an hour meter reset on 24 Oct.
open_questions.effect: If the register is right and they are idle, 4 more hires could end: +$5,636.55 a day. As it stands they are not offered.
open_questions.ask: For each: is it in the yard, or out working? If working, which job, so the register can be updated.

open_questions.title: Are these machines idle? FieldTrax can't tell us.
open_questions.finding: BE GN-02, BE SK-05, NH GN-01 are Available, but have no FieldTrax data for 18–31 Oct, so they can't be confirmed idle.
open_questions.effect: 3 hires ($1,024.00 a day) depend on them and are shown as unconfirmed.
open_questions.ask: Confirm each is sitting in the yard and fit to go out.

open_questions.title: What are the spare trackers fitted to?
open_questions.finding: Spare tracker 1, Spare tracker 2 and Spare tracker 3 match no machine on the register, but ran 28.0, 15.3 and 21.3 h between 18 and 31 Oct (reporting since 22 Oct). Each is fitted to something that is working.
open_questions.effect: If one is on BE GN-02, BE SK-05 or NH GN-01 (Available, no FieldTrax data of their own), that machine is working and its proposal falls away: up to $1,024.00 a day. 7 other machines in use have no tracker either.
open_questions.ask: Which machine each spare tracker is fitted to, so FieldTrax can be linked to the register.

open_questions.title: Were these dates entered day-first?
open_questions.finding: Dates are read day-first (2/4/26 = 2 Apr). Read month-first, 5 dates would change whether a hire is open on 31 Oct: H-1015 start 11 Oct would be 10 Nov (Excel date); H-1046 start 11 Mar would be 3 Nov (Excel date); H-1010 off-hire 10 Nov would be 11 Oct (Excel date); H-1035 start 12 Jul would be 7 Dec (typed d/m/y); H-1042 start 11 Jul would be 7 Nov (Excel date).
open_questions.effect: 3 of them are in proposals (H-1015, H-1046, H-1042, $3,346.37 a day). If their dates were entered month-first, those hires were not open on 31 Oct and drop out of the answer.
open_questions.ask: Confirm these were entered day-first (Australian), or correct them.

open_questions.title: Is H-1014 one hire or two?
open_questions.finding: H-1014 is on rows 14 and 15 of Hires 25-26, identical in every cell. Counted once.
open_questions.effect: If it is two machines, another $395.66 a day is on hire. No idle skid steer is left in QLD to replace it.
open_questions.ask: One hire entered twice (we'll mark the second line), or two machines (it needs its own hire number).

open_questions.title: What is NH TP-05's VIN?
open_questions.finding: The register's VIN is blank. FieldTrax tracker on rego AQ183S reports VIN BLK0TT4CWJ58R3HFJ. 3 other machines also have no VIN (EX-06, LV-07 and SK-03); they aren't in any proposal.
open_questions.effect: It is the machine proposed for H-1043 ($1,290.00 a day). The tracker showing it idle is matched by rego only.
open_questions.ask: Confirm the VIN so the register and the tracker agree.

open_questions.title: Is 'Hire Well' the same company as Hirewell Pty Ltd?
open_questions.finding: 'Hire Well' is written as two words on 5 lines. We read it as Hirewell Pty Ltd.
open_questions.effect: Doesn't change the saving; it decides which supplier is asked to off-hire.
open_questions.ask: Same company, or a different supplier?

open_questions.title: What notice or minimum hire do the suppliers need?
open_questions.finding: Notice periods and minimum hire terms aren't in the register. 3 of the hires to end are on weekly rates.
open_questions.effect: The day saving may start later than the day a hire ends; a weekly or monthly hire may be charged to the end of its period.
open_questions.ask: Each supplier's notice period and minimum hire, or where the contracts are kept.

open_questions.title: Which BE total is right?
open_questions.finding: The typed BE total is $10,276,000.00; the machine lines add up to $10,361,000.00 ($85,000.00 more). The typed subtotals agree with the lines.
open_questions.effect: Doesn't change today's answer.
open_questions.ask: Which figure should the BE register total show?

open_questions.title: What did these machines cost?
open_questions.finding: Capital cost says TBC for BE SK-01 and RL-01.
open_questions.effect: Doesn't change today's answer.
open_questions.ask: The capital cost for each machine marked TBC.

open_questions.title: Built and disposed in 2026?
open_questions.finding: BE SK-03 and WC-03 are Disposed, but their Year is 2026.
open_questions.effect: Doesn't change today's answer.
open_questions.ask: Is the Year or the Status wrong on these lines?

open_questions.title: Should these machines have trackers?
open_questions.finding: 10 machines in use or Available have no FieldTrax device: BE GN-01, BE GN-02, BE GN-03, BE SK-05, BE TP-10, NH GN-01, NH GN-02, NH LV-02, NH RL-01 and NH TP-07.
open_questions.effect: Doesn't change today's answer.
open_questions.ask: Are generators tracked? Are the others missing a device?

open_questions.title: Do 'On job' and 'Repairs' mean On project and Workshop?
open_questions.finding: NH writes 'On job' (21 lines) and 'Repairs' (4 lines). We read them as On project and Workshop.
open_questions.effect: Doesn't change today's answer.
open_questions.ask: Confirm how NH's status words map to BE's.

open_questions.title: Is one operator on two machines?
open_questions.finding: BE LV-03 and BE SK-01 share operator mobile 0491 555 646. BE LV-08 and BE TP-10 share operator mobile 0491 555 341. (Hidden column K on BE Plant.)
open_questions.effect: Doesn't change today's answer.
open_questions.ask: Is it the same operator on both, or has a number been copied across?
